title: PHASEMAP: exact second-order classification for deterministic reset maps of an inertial active particle
description: Exact analytic classification, deterministic validation, unresolved trajectory-attempt records, figures, manuscript, and reproducibility software for all seven nonempty deterministic reset maps of a two-dimensional inertial active Brownian particle.

creators.name: Pierpoint, G. Blake
creators.affiliation: Department of Biomedical Engineering, Whiting School of Engineering, Johns Hopkins University

creators.name: Bernard, Olivier
creators.affiliation: UFR PhITEM, Universite Grenoble Alpes; Weyl Center for Mathematical Physics

creators.name: Liu, Yichen
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Weyl Center for Mathematical Physics

notes: The analytic classification is exact. S-021 provides finite-grid deterministic validation. S-071 and S-073 remain quantitatively unresolved and are not pooled, retried, topped up, or represented as quantitative validation.
